title: Gligar - SV04: Paradox Rift Reverse Holo 091/182
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Gligar card from the Paradox Rift set is a must-have for any Pokémon TCG collector. With a vibrant Reverse Holo finish and a rarity of Common, this Basic stage card is sure to impress. Featuring the beloved character Gligar, this English language card is manufactured by The Pokémon Company and has a card number of 091/182. 

The card is a standard size and is perfect for adding to your collection or using in battles. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this unique and rare card.
